verses.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਕੈ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨ ਚਉਦਹ ਵੰਡਿ ਲੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: kheer samu(n)dh virolikai kadd ratan chaudheh va(n)dd leete|

en.bdb: Having churned the ocean the fourteen jewels were taken out and were distributed (among the gods and demons).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਣਿ੧ ਲਖਮੀ੨ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ੩ ਸੰਖੁ੪ ਸਾਰੰਗ੫ ਧਣਖੁ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: mani1 lakhamee2 paarajaata3 sa(n)khu4 saara(n)ga5 dhanakh bisan vas keete|

en.bdb: Visnu got hold of gem, Laksami; wish fulfilling tree-parijat, conch, bow named sarang. .

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ੧ ਤੇ ਅਪਛਰਾਂ੨ ਐਰਾਪਤਿ੩ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਸੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaamadhenu1 te apachharaa(n)2 aairaapati3 i(n)dhraasan seete|

en.bdb: Wish fulfilling cow nymphs, Air5vat elephant were attached to the throne of lndr i.e. they were given him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਕੂਟ੧ ਤੇ ਅਰਧ ਚੰਦੁ੨ ਮਹਾਂਦੇਵ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਪੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaalakooTa1 te aradh cha(n)dhu2 mahaa(n)dhev masatak dhar peete|

en.bdb: Mahadev drank the deadly poison and adorned crescent moon on his forehead.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੋੜਾ੧ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੂਰਜੈ ਮਦੁ੨ ਅੰਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ੩ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਰੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: ghoRaa1 miliaa soorajai madhu2 a(n)mitru3 dhev dhaanav reete|

en.bdb: Sun got the horse and the wine and amrit were emptied by the gods and demons jointly .

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਧਨੰਤਰੁ੧ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਡਸਿਆ ਤੱਛਕਿ ਮਤਿ ਬਿਪਰੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: kare dhana(n)taru1 vaidhagee ddasiaa ta'chhak mat bipareete|

en.bdb: Dhanvantrt used to practise medicine but stung by Taksak, the snake, his wisdom got inverted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਮੋਲਕਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਿਧਿ ਅਗਣੀਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes amolakaa ratan padhaarath nidh aganeete|

en.bdb: In the ocean of the teachings of the Guru, exist innumerable invaluable jewels.
The Sikh's true love is for the Guru alone.
